responsibility: Declares the scoped expression and const/copy table abstractions used by dominator-based tree SSA optimizers. It defines hashable_expr, cond_equivalence, expr_hash_elt, the expression-table hasher, and the avail_exprs_stack and const_and_copies unwindable stacks that record available expressions and SSA_NAME_VALUE-style equivalences across dominator-tree traversal scopes.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the scoped-table data model and public abstractions—hashable_expr, cond_equivalence, expr_hash_elt, avail_exprs_stack, and const_and_copies—used by DOM-style optimizers. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-scopedtables.cc, it does not contain the simplification, hash-table update, or unwind mechanics.
